verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a founder-focused immigration and startup law firm. A service business like this could plausibly offer an official MCP server, for example for case intake or status, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no MCP server: the probes found only an llms.txt file, and every OpenAPI candidate path returned 404. Neither of these is an MCP server, so absence of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
